a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (singer) agrees to practice later in the day.

a2.text: (neighbor) discovers (singer) had not realized how far the sound carried.

b1.text: (singer) finds a pleasant spot near the shore.

b2.text: The new location bothers (fisher), a fisher, requiring another adjustment.

c1.text: (neighbor) joins for one song and enjoys it.

d1.text: (neighbor) becomes less irritated after discussing expectations.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (singer) decides to compromise without giving up the hobby.
